examples.title: Rainbow fan
examples.description: Thirty-two lines fan out from a single point in fifteen colours, using the SAM's 16-colour MODE 4 and SAM BASIC's DRAW TO.

examples.title: Circle maker
examples.description: Type a radius and the SAM draws that circle in a random colour and works out its area; type 0 to stop.

examples.title: Higher or lower
examples.description: A card from 1 to 13 is dealt; press H or L to guess whether the next one is higher or lower, and see how long your run lasts.
